critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: AdminDiagnostics.js had infinite loop due to useCallback dependencies on unstable api object. Fixed by using useRef to stabilize api reference.
FIXED: loadAll function now uses try/finally to ensure loading state is set to false even on errors.
Minor: Recharts ResponsiveContainer shows width/height -1 warnings when chart container has no explicit dimensions - cosmetic issue only.
seed_data_creation: Created test frontend crash reports and triggered test error/slow endpoints during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 tested the new diagnostics system. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend had an infinite loop bug in AdminDiagnostics.js due to unstable useCallback dependencies - fixed by using useRef. The diagnostics dashboard now shows: summary cards, error rate chart, paginated errors table with filters, error detail modal with resolve functionality, and performance tab with slowest endpoints/P95 data. TTL indexes are set on error_logs (90 days) and performance_logs (30 days).

bugs_fixed.issue: Infinite loop causing page to be stuck in loading state
bugs_fixed.root_cause: useCallback dependencies included unstable 'api' object from useApi() hook, causing fetchSummary/fetchErrors/fetchPerformance to be recreated on every render, which triggered useEffect repeatedly
bugs_fixed.fix: Used useRef to store api reference and removed api from useCallback dependencies. Also changed useEffect dependencies to empty array for initial load and filters-only for filter changes.
